title: Annual report of emergency contraception dispensed under M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 19A
rule_summary: A pharmacist dispensing emergency contraception under M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 19A shall annually provide to the department the number of times such emergency contraception is dispensed. Reports made pursuant to s. 19A shall not identify any individual patient, shall be confidential and shall not be public records as defined by clause Twenty-sixth of section 7 of chapter 4 or section 10 of chapter 66.
exam_relevance: Tests the annual frequency, the actor, the count reported, the bar on identifying any individual patient, and the confidential and non-public-record status of the reports.
common_confusions: Treating the reports as available on a public records request.
Reporting only upon request rather than annually.
Identifying individual patients in the report.
verification_notes: Read in the current text of M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 19A on malegislature.gov on 2026-09-14.
